h1: Wix app redesign that keeps your users and data
overview: A tidy interface makes an app feel trustworthy. We review your dashboard pages and site widgets, then redesign them with the Wix Design System so they match the rest of the Wix dashboard. We improve layouts, empty states, forms and widget panels, rebuild them in code, keep your features and data unchanged and check how the widgets look on desktop and phone.

faq: Will my site owners lose their settings?
No. We replace the look of the screens and keep your data and settings as they are. Owners open the app and find the same options in a cleaner layout.
Do you use the Wix Design System?
Yes. It is Wix's own component library, so your dashboard looks native, supports accessibility basics out of the box and is easier to keep up to date.
Can you restyle the widget inside the Wix editor?
Yes. We refresh the widget's look and its settings panel in the editor. We also check how it behaves on mobile view, where many widgets break.
Do you create designs before building?
Yes. We share mockups of the first screens for approval, then build the rest in the same style. The Premium package adds an editable Figma file of every page.
